Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: six modular environment patches for a Chinese historical top-down JRPG.
Edit target: the supplied 1536x1024 sprite sheet. Preserve EXACT canvas, six patch bounding rectangles, position, scale, geometry, objects and orientation. Every magenta pixel outside the rectangular patches must remain flat magenta. Do not add borders, labels or text.
Primary request: redraw the six patches into beautifully crafted modern high-resolution pixel art. Retain clearly visible small square pixels, deliberate clustered shading, crisp edges, detailed wood carving, refined celadon stone floors, warm red lacquer and antique gold. More readable and refined than the old Mega Drive art. No blurry painting, no photorealism, no smooth 3D, no glow or cinematic lighting. Consistent overhead light and orthographic RPG perspective.
Patch rectangles in output pixels, x/y/width/height: floor 192/192/128/128; wall and window 576/64/384/384; tea table and four stools 1088/64/384/384; folding screen and chair 64/576/384/384; shelf and landscape painting 576/576/384/384; small chest 1216/704/128/128.
Keep every floor paving seam and furniture footprint in the identical position. Preserve black areas. Increase internal pixel detail, not object size. The floor patch has four 64x64 paving squares; keep those exact boundaries and consistent green palette in all patches. Furniture and architecture must not extend beyond original silhouettes. Retain all four stools, two tea objects, six screen panels, chair, shelf contents and painting. No new objects or characters.
